composition.note: The source catalogue gives Verdi’s death year as 1901. This does not determine rights in the 1929 recording.

recording.value: The source claims worldwide public-domain status; present US recording clearance is not established.
recording.note: The source catalogue’s US-expiry and worldwide claims cannot be treated as current legal clearance. Under § 1401, a recording first published in 1929 or the source’s tentative 1930 would ordinarily still have US protection in 2026. The exact first-publication year remains unresolved. The CC BY-SA notice on the catalogue website covers its text, not automatically this sound recording.

alternatives.value: Public-domain recording worldwide — claim made by the Public Domain Project and reproduced by Commons.
US pre-1972 sound-recording law provides a continuing term for a 1929/1930 first publication; no separate US permission is established.
